name: Unit rule
summary: An arity-1 H-box with label 1 is a phase-free Z-spider.
description: An arity-1 H-box with label $1$ is the (co)vector $\langle 0| + \langle 1|$, which is exactly the phase-free arity-1 Z-spider. See the [generalised unit rule](../zh-unit-generalised/) for H-boxes of any arity labelled $1$, which completely disconnect.
